title: Cesarino Italian Restaurant
role: Team Project — Lead Interior Designer & Site Coordinator
materials: Exposed brick, natural oak timber, cream ceramic tile, dark green joinery, antique brass
description: A warm Italian dining atmosphere shaped by exposed brick arches, dark green detailing, natural timber, and layered ambient lighting.
details: Cesarino Puri is an Italian restaurant in Jakarta inspired by the warmth and character of traditional Italian dining. The interior combines exposed brick, warm timber, and soft ambient lighting to create an intimate and welcoming atmosphere.

title: Sour Sally City Centre, Dubai
materials: Brushed stainless steel, lime-green solid surfaces, white laminate, illuminated acrylic, LED lighting
description: A dynamic frozen-yogurt retail environment combining Sour Sally’s signature green identity with fluid forms, integrated lighting, and a contemporary metallic material palette.
details: Sour Sally Deira is a contemporary frozen-yogurt retail concept in Dubai, combining Sour Sally’s signature green identity with a clean, futuristic interior language. Curved forms, illuminated details, and brushed-metal finishes create a bright and energetic customer experience.

title: EVD Vocational High School
materials: Exposed structural steel, aluminium composite panels, glass curtain walls, concrete, and neutral-toned architectural finishes
description: A contemporary vocational campus organized around connected learning spaces, technical workshops, and landscaped courtyards to support hands-on education in electronic vehicle development.
details: EVD SMK is a modern vocational education campus in Cimahi dedicated to Electric Vehicle Development and technical learning. The campus combines academic, laboratory, workshop, sports, and communal facilities within a contemporary and highly connected educational environment.

title: Geo Gymnas
materials: Exposed concrete, dark metal structure, glass curtain walls, timber flooring, perforated metal railings, and landscaped greenery
description: A contemporary public sports environment that integrates functional athletic spaces, flexible programming, natural light, and strong connections between indoor and outdoor areas.
details: GEO Gymnas – Bandung is a contemporary public sports facility designed as a multifunctional environment for athletic activities, recreation, and community use. Combining modern architectural forms with expansive sports halls, generous glazing, landscaped outdoor areas, and flexible spaces that support a variety of sporting activities.

title: Juicy Sally Booth
materials: Pink illuminated acrylic, black laminate, LED lighting, digital display panels, graphic vinyl, and glossy accent finishes
description: A bold and playful F&B booth that translates Juicy Sally’s youthful brand identity into a highly visible retail experience through vibrant color, graphic expression, integrated lighting, and distinctive character elements.
details: Juicy Sally – Sour Sally Group is a vibrant F&B kiosk concept designed around a bold, youthful, and playful visual identity. The booth combines vivid pink tones, black accents, illuminated graphics, and the signature Juicy Sally character to create a highly recognizable presence within a contemporary retail environment.

title: Juicy Sally — Summarecon Mall Serpong
materials: Pink illuminated acrylic, black laminate, LED lighting, digital display panels, graphic vinyl, and glossy accent finishes
description: A bold and immersive F&B retail unit that expresses Juicy Sally’s playful identity through vibrant graphics, integrated lighting, strong contrast, and a highly recognizable branded environment.
details: Juicy Sally – Summarecon Mall Serpong is a vibrant F&B retail unit developed for the Juicy Sally brand, translating its playful and energetic identity into a compact mall environment. The design combines bold pink graphics, black finishes, integrated LED lighting, and signature character elements to create a distinctive and highly visible customer-facing space.

title: Housing Complex Reimagine
materials: Clay roof tiles, natural stone, timber finishes, textured white walls, porcelain flooring, glass, and warm LED lighting
description: A warm contemporary residential environment combining functional compact living spaces with natural materials, tropical landscaping, and a consistent architectural language across the housing cluster.
details: Residential Housing Complex is a contemporary tropical housing development designed around a warm, modern residential character. The architecture combines pitched clay-tile roofs, natural stone, timber elements, and landscaped communal areas, creating a cohesive and comfortable environment across the housing units.

title: Mixed-Use Shopping Mall
materials: Natural stone, textured concrete, glass curtain wall, metal fins, dark metal roofing, timber accents, and landscape elements
description: A contemporary mixed-use retail environment designed around visual connectivity, pedestrian-oriented public spaces, natural landscaping, and a strong relationship between indoor and outdoor activities.
details: Mixed-Use Shopping Mall is an academic architectural project exploring a contemporary retail destination that combines commercial spaces, dining, entertainment, and public gathering areas. The design emphasizes a modern façade with vertical shading elements, generous glazing, landscaped open spaces, and a central courtyard that connects the building with its surrounding public realm.

title: Bhumi — Bandung Mixed-Use Mall
materials: Glass curtain wall, white architectural panels, dark metal elements, horizontal fins, textured façade surfaces, and integrated landscape
description: A contextual mixed-use development that integrates commercial activity with public open space, pedestrian connectivity, and the surrounding urban landscape.
details: Bhumi – Bandung Mixed-Use Mall is a competition project exploring a contemporary commercial destination at the intersection of Jl. Alun-Alun Timur and Jl. Dalem Kaum, Bandung. The design responds to its urban context by establishing a strong connection between Alun-Alun Bandung, the surrounding streets, and the Cikapundung River, while introducing public open spaces and pedestrian-oriented connections.

title: RH House
materials: Light brick, timber, black metal, glass, stone, concrete, greenery.
description: A contemporary tropical residence with a warm, natural character. The exterior combines clean architectural forms with greenery and inviting semi-outdoor spaces.
details: To create a seamless connection between architecture, landscape, and outdoor living. The pergola, integrated planting, and natural materials soften the building while providing comfortable transitional spaces.

title: Scandinavian House
materials: White plaster, light timber, sage green, dark grey roofing, black metal, concrete pavers, greenery.
description: A Scandinavian-inspired residential development with a clean and contemporary architectural character. The design combines simple gabled forms, soft colors, natural timber, and landscaped front gardens.
details: To create a warm and welcoming residential environment through simple forms, natural materials, and a restrained color palette. Repetitive gabled façades and integrated greenery establish a cohesive identity while maintaining a comfortable neighborhood scale.

title: Sour Sally Pekanbaru
materials: Stainless steel, grey laminate, lime green acrylic, white solid surface, black graphic panels, LED lighting.
description: A contemporary Sour Sally frozen yogurt kiosk designed with a bold lime green, black, and white visual identity. The compact layout integrates ordering, preparation, display, and customer seating into a cohesive branded environment.
details: To create a playful and highly recognizable retail experience that reflects Sour Sally’s energetic brand character. Curved forms, illuminated details, graphic patterns, and branded elements are used to enhance visibility and customer engagement.

title: Sour Sally GH Mall, Philippines
materials: Stainless steel, dark laminate, lime green acrylic, glass, graphic vinyl, LED lighting.
description: A Sour Sally frozen yogurt outlet designed as a compact branded retail space with an integrated service counter and customer seating. The interior combines dark metallic finishes with vibrant lime green accents, illuminated graphics, and playful brand elements.
details: To translate the Sour Sally brand identity into a strong and recognizable spatial experience. Graphic patterns, illuminated details, reflective surfaces, and branded elements create a playful yet contemporary atmosphere.

title: Sour Sally Lulu Centre, Dubai
materials: Stainless steel, white tiles, green laminate/acrylic, glass, graphic vinyl, LED lighting, porcelain tiles, artificial greenery.
description: A branded frozen yogurt outlet with an open layout combining service, display, and customer seating areas. The interior features a fresh green palette, greenery, and bold Sour Sally graphics.
details: To create a fresh, healthy, and contemporary retail atmosphere while maintaining a strong Sour Sally identity. The design combines greenery, illuminated details, stainless steel, and graphic elements to create a vibrant customer experience.

title: Weekend House
materials: White render, exposed brick, natural wood, dark roofing, black aluminum frames, concrete, stone paving, greenery.
description: A compact multi-unit weekend house development designed as a private retreat surrounded by greenery. The project features repeated gabled volumes, private outdoor areas, and an integrated swimming pool within the development.
details: To create a warm and relaxing getaway with a contemporary tropical character. The design combines simple architectural forms, natural materials, abundant greenery, and indoor-outdoor connections to create a comfortable retreat environment.

title: WePadl
materials: Textured plaster, terracotta tiles, dark metal roofing, glass, natural stone, concrete, black metal framing, and landscape planting.
description: A contemporary lifestyle and wellness-oriented commercial building designed around a strong architectural identity and a warm, earthy material palette. The project combines sculptural textured façades with extensive glazing, vertical terracotta elements, and a large articulated roof.
details: The design creates a distinctive yet approachable commercial environment through the contrast of soft sculptural forms and warm natural materials. Rounded plaster volumes frame large glazed openings, while terracotta brick/tile screens provide texture and solar filtering. The large dark metal roof unifies the building's different volumes and gives the project a strong overall silhouette.
